description: Déraciné (CUSA11919) gameplay, reached headlessly: emulated PSVR, no OpenXR host and no physical headset, from savedata slot 1 (stage m00_00_10_10) via the M2 scripted Move sequence. Measurement is the emulator's own unique-rendered-frame series (frame stats), not the compositor.

menu_disambiguation.note: The menu/front end is ~465-500 draws and cannot pass the 800-draw gate; a run that never leaves it is reported phase=menu, never as gameplay.

save.note: Slot 1 makes Continue load the classroom; the quality-lab save (slot 0, m00_00_80_10) stays on the menu forever. The three files are pinned by sha256; they are game/user data and are not committed.

input.note: The script is the M2 confirm sweep: it aims the mirrored Move hand at Continue and presses it. All of it is test-only and off unless these variables are set.

image_reference_note: No gameplay eye reference is installed. A candidate exists (_build/headless/validation/evidence/gameplay-reference-candidate/gameplay-eye-m2-confirm-1.png, menu-vs-gameplay SSIM 0.4174) but it was never visually reviewed and installed. Until it is, scene identity rests on the numeric gate+band, which the menu cannot satisfy; an optional reference can be added here and checked by scene_signature.py.

reproducibility.note: M2 has been proven in one independently constructed lab (scene-eng's). It is NOT yet reproducible from a second independently constructed lab, so a valid cell here is single-lab evidence until that second lab passes.
